## Before you ask for a review

- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): summary`, such as `fix(os): …` ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mixoshq/mixos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests)).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [DCO](https://github.com/mixoshq/mixos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-off-every-commit-dco).
- [ ] New platform files start with the MPL notice ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mixoshq/mixos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#new-platform-files-need-the-licence-notice)).
- [ ] No extension folders beyond the ones the core carries. Your own apps, connectors and themes stay in your own repository.
